appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Monthly Sales for Store B in City Y'.
Y-axis has labeled ticks at intervals of 50, from 0 to 500.
X-axis has labeled ticks for 'April', 'May', and 'June'.
Chart contains one bar series for each month: April, May, June.
A horizontal dashed line labeled 'Average' is drawn at the 300 sales level.

printed_facts.fact: April bar height corresponds to approximately 475 on the 'Sales' axis.
May bar height corresponds to approximately 295 on the 'Sales' axis.
June bar height corresponds to exactly 300 on the 'Sales' axis, aligned with the 'Average' line.
The 'Average' line is positioned at 300 on the 'Sales' axis and extends across the chart.

public_definitions: Goal: Review the Store B monthly sales dashboard for April through June, then complete the June sales operations routing form by choosing the appropriate route.
Comparison scope: June sales performance relative to the average and prior months (April, May).

Rules: Use the dashboard as the evidence source for the June route decision. Route options are: 'Route June to low-sales response', 'Keep June on normal sales monitoring', 'Route June to strong-sales response'.
